description: Move a page or a folder into another folder, or to the wiki root. Links survive a move — they point at the id, not the path — so reorganising is safe.

destination_folder_path.description: Path of the destination folder. Omit to move it to the root.

node_id.description: Id of the page or folder to move, from get_wiki_tree.

node_type.description: Which of the two it is.

workspace_slug.description: The workspace slug, from any Monnet URL (e.g. 'monnet-team-410b'). Call list_workspaces if you do not have it.

name: move_wiki_node
